# debian/sway/under_test.txt - programs being tried under sway, not
# installed by the build. Try one with: sudo apt install <PACKAGE>
# When it works well: move it to tested.txt (or packages.txt). When it
# does not: move it to discarded.txt with the reason.
#
# Web browsers
firefox-esr
epiphany-browser
qutebrowser
# Qt 6 programs under sway need these (Recommends of libqt6gui6, not
# installed by default): without qt6-wayland no Qt 6 program starts
qt6-wayland
qt6-svg-plugins
# SVG icons for GTK programs
librsvg2-common
# fonts for web pages
fonts-liberation2
# PDF reader (config in ~/.config/zathura is already there)
zathura
zathura-pdf-poppler
# Music and video
audacious
mpv
# Databases
sqlitebrowser
# Touch: on-screen keyboard, edge gestures (not set up yet)
wvkbd
lisgd
# Screenshots and clipboard
grim
slurp
wl-clipboard
# GPU check and benchmark
mesa-utils
glmark2-es2-wayland
# Input debugging (libinput debug-events)
libinput-tools
